litegs_local_patch: COLMAP loader uses sparse/ instead of sparse/0/; no algorithm patch.

inputs.construction: Preserve all source points and repeat the last 24,896 rows to reach 1,000,000 input Gaussians; both backends add the same final 64 rows for 128-point clusters.

fixed_protocol: Three sequential repeats per version, same PLY/view/rates, 30 warmup updates and 300 timed updates; SH=3, Optax for JAX, no densification; native LiteGS sparse Adam. XLA/CuTe compilation excluded.

training_compilation.scope: XLA memory plan, not measured peak GPU memory

conclusion: No material end-to-end throughput gain measured. Fixed-count and full training are essentially unchanged; densification is faster by 8-24%, SH0 compiler temporary memory falls by about 86.7 MiB, and per-step sort-selector D2H was removed.
